& ſeduire par dons, preſens, blãdices, Promeſſes, & autre

ment ſi coniointe, qu'vne fẽme, ou vn enfãt {c}, plus chers
ſans cõparaiſon au mari, ou au pere, qu'a toutes les cho-
ſes les plus precieuſes du monde {d}.
Et diſcourant mieux encor le faict, deſ-
duiſoit, qu'ayant demeuré ſept ou huict
ans, au ſeruice du Roy à la guerre, & quel
ques mois aux Eſpaignes pour voir le
pays, deſireux de reuoir ſes parens, ſa pa-
trie, Sanxi ſon enfant, & plus encor ladite
de Rols ſa femme: ſ'en ſeroit trois ans y
a & d'auantage, retourné audit lieu d'Ar-
tigat.
Ces trois eſguillions ici, eſtoyent à la verité biens
poignans, pour faire reuenir vn perſonnage de loing
tain pais; à ſçauoir La douceur de la partie, La charité
des enfans, & L'amour de la femme. Car quant à la pa-
trie: à peine pourroit-on exprimer (dit en quelque lieu
Ciceron) ce qu'elle contient de douceur, de plaiſir d'a-
mour, & de volupté {a}. laquelle infiniment grande, fait
qu'vn autre pays, bien qu'il ſoit plus beau, plaiſant, &
fertile, ne ſera pourtant iamais trouué ſi gracieux, ni
delectable {b2}. teſmoing Vliſſes, lequel iadis oſa bien pre
ferer Ithaque (d'ou il eſtoit natif) pierreuſe aſsiſe com
me vn petit nid parmi les apres rochers, & preſqu' in-
acceſſible à l'ĩmortalité, que Calypſo la nymphe luy a-
uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
Neſcio qua natale ſolum, dulcedine cunctos
Ducit, & immemores, non ſinit eſſe ſui.

uncertain.text: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
uncertain.note: the marker after 'dit' is printed as an italic q with a full descender, so it is transcribed {q}; but the matching citation in the margin is keyed d (transcribed d2 here, 'Ouid. au j. de Ponto.'), and the annotation's other markers run a, b, c. Almost certainly a compositor's wrong sort for d. So marker q has no note, and note key d2 has no marker. Escalating for the reconciler.

uncertain.text: uoit offeret {c2}. Auquel propos Ouide dit {q},
uncertain.note: sic: the word before the marker reads o-ff-e-r-e-t at 14x, i.e. 'offeret' where the sense wants 'offerte' (Calypso had offered it to him). Looks like a transposed e/t. Transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: tain pais; à ſçauoir La douceur de la partie, La charité
uncertain.note: punctuation after 'pais' checked at 9x: upper dot plus a comma with a tail below the baseline, i.e. a semicolon, not the colon the sense would suggest. Compare 'trie:' on blocks[4].lines[4], which is two round dots.

uncertain.text: me vn petit nid parmi les apres rochers, & preſqu' in-
uncertain.note: the compositor sets a clear word space after the apostrophe of 'preſqu'', with 'in-' hyphenated to 'acceſſible' on the next line. Kept as printed ('preſqu' in-') rather than closed up to 'preſqu'in-'.

the final letter of 'ad I.' is a straight stroke with top and bottom serifs (italic capital I), unlike the looped italic lowercase l that opens the same line. The citation is 'C. ad l. Falcidiam', so the sense wants lowercase l; transcribed as the capital shape printed.
a small raised tick stands between 'Falc.' and 'de' at ascender height. It may be a badly inked 'l.' (a further citation) or a broken sort; not transcribable as a letter, so omitted from the line.
last abbreviation read at 9x as 'can.' (the final letter arches over at the top, so n rather than u); the citation is D. quod metus causa, where 'cau.' would be expected. Transcribed as printed.
the mark after 'finale' is a low round dot with an ink speck above it; read as a period, but a colon cannot be ruled out.

the marker alphabet restarts at 'a' with ANNOTAT. XVI, so the page carries two runs: b, c, d in the paragraph continued from p030, then a, b, c, (q) in the annotation. Per §4 the repeated letters are keyed b2, c2, d2 in both the body and the notes; the first 'a' of the second run keeps the plain key a.
